payload.summary: Mid-plan handoff requested for a model switch. The dispatch-governance dg-07 implementation is merged and recorded complete. The stale PCA roadmap was reconciled through merged PR 626, making pca-02 the canonical ready item. Discovery defaults are approved and proposal.md is drafted, but Gate 1 approach selection has not yet been answered; do not generate specs, design, tasks, contracts, or work packages until it is.
completed_work: Merged dg-07 PR 625 and pushed roadmap completion commit 4b6304d5 to openspec/add-adaptive-model-router.
Merged PCA reconciliation PR 626 into main; pca-01 is completed and pca-02 is the canonical planning checkpoint.
Ran three read-only planning explorations covering specs, code/test seams, and architecture boundaries.
Verified Python 3.12+, hvac 2.4.0 in both lockfiles, and identified the mutable OpenBao latest image as a reproducibility gap.
Fetched official OpenBao response-wrapping, AppRole, KV-v2 policy, audit, and hvac 2.4.0 KV documentation.
Created proposal.md with three approaches and measurable NFRs; no post-Gate-1 artifacts have been generated.
in_progress: Plan-feature Gate 1 direction approval for pca-02.
The change scaffold and proposal are intentionally uncommitted until the complete approved plan is generated.

decisions.title: Use bounded last-known-good identity reload
decisions.rationale: The operator approved a 30-second refresh cadence, at most 120 seconds of stale acceptance, audited degradation, then denial of new authentication.

decisions.title: Declare vendor credential scope in the registry
decisions.rationale: The operator approved explicit vendor_credentials on agent entries instead of inference from policy vendor or CLI configuration.

decisions.title: Deliver wrapped bootstrap bundles as protected files
decisions.rationale: The operator approved one atomically written mode-0600 bundle per principal under an explicit mode-0700 directory, never stdout or git.

decisions.title: Keep the pca-02 to dg-08 boundary narrow
decisions.rationale: pca-02 supplies the egress-gateway AppRole, vendor-only policy, and wrapped bootstrap; iron-proxy and per-dispatch proxy-token authorization remain dg-08 and pca-04 work.

next_steps: Ask the operator to select Gate 1 if no answer followed this handoff; recommend Approach 1.
After approval, replace the pending Selected Approach section and generate strict delta specs for agent-identity, configuration, and agent-coordinator.
Generate design.md, machine-readable topology/bootstrap/audit contracts, TDD-ordered tasks.md, and a contract-first work-package DAG.
Run multi-vendor plan review to convergence, strict OpenSpec/package validation, write the final Plan phase record, commit, push, and request Gate 2 approval before implementation.
Do not implement pca-03 session tokens, dg-08 iron-proxy, or pca-04 proxy-token issuance in pca-02.
